testingFeedback: 20 distinct issues were recorded in tests/ISSUES.md; all were fixed.
6 were critical: two startup failures, pause handling, self-intersecting rays, multiplayer readiness and out-of-order objective completion.
The complete campaign bot, using real objective actions through both endings and a permanent buddy loss.
The empty-scene hub smoke test was least representative; full-world tests exposed startup work it could not catch.
engineFeedback: Native model and clip data made original art practical. Headless stepping made the whole campaign testable.
Yes: a custom model id collided with the library, ray exclusions belonged in the fifth argument, and full-scene GPU precompilation exceeded the multiplayer startup window.

aiHub.name: Hardly Far Cry
aiHub.description: An original first-person survival shooter in the Sorrel. Read the wind, clear a rusted gun, survive the fever, and decide who deserves the only honest map.
aiHub.controls: WASD/mouse or standard pad; R2/LMB fire, L2/RMB aim, Square/E use, R reload, L1/Q heal, H tablet, M map, G bottle, Esc pause.
